description: Look up a Brazilian company by 14-digit CNPJ tax ID — returns name, address, CNAE codes, QSA partners, capital, status from Receita Federal. BrasilAPI MIT

cnpj.description: Brazilian company tax ID (CNPJ) — 14 digits with or without punctuation (e.g. "33000167000101" or "33.000.167/0001-01"). Returns full Receita Federal company registry data.

name: gov.brasilapi.cnpj
